The opportunity

The commercial engine room of Melrose

Melrose is a Brisbane builder and developer under one roof, growing fast across multi-residential, fit-out and refurbishment, and its own development pipeline. With $120m of work this year and 15 projects on the books, the business needs a Commercial Manager who looks after the numbers across all of it.

This is a corporate role, not a project resource. You won’t be tied to one site. You’ll sit across both sides of the business, working month on month with the team leaders to forecast, control cost and keep a close eye on contingency and risk.

You’ll start across the fit-out and refurbishment work, then step into construction. You’ll report to the Managing Director and work hand in hand with the Finance Manager on month-end.

Every project in the business runs through your numbers. You’ll be the one who sees the whole picture.

Month on month

See the movement before anyone else

Your rhythm is the month. You’ll sit down with each team leader, work through the forecast and cost to complete, and make sure the WIP and accruals are right before month-end closes with finance.

You’ll track movement in contingency across the portfolio, flag risk early and help the leadership team make good calls. You’ll also back the procurement function, sharpening scopes of works and getting the most out of ProcurePro.

The role

Know the numbers. Protect the margin.

What you’ll do

  • Own forecasting and cost control across all projects in both parts of the business.
  • Start with the fit-out and refurbishment work, then step into construction.
  • Run monthly cost and forecast reviews with each team leader.
  • Prepare WIP and accruals in JobPac and work with the Finance Manager on month-end.
  • Track contingency and risk across the portfolio and report the movement.
  • Support procurement with scopes of works and ProcurePro.
  • Give the Managing Director a clear, honest view of the numbers.

Who we’re looking for

  • Highly proficient in JobPac. This is essential.
  • A Commercial Manager, Senior Commercial Manager or senior QS from a builder.
  • Experience managing cost across a portfolio of projects, not just one.
  • Strong on forecasting, WIP, accruals, cost to complete and month-end.
  • Fit-out, refurbishment and residential or multi-residential construction experience.
  • A great communicator who builds trust with delivery teams.
  • Looking for a long-term home with a builder that’s growing fast.
